title: Analytic and quasiregular distortion of Nagata dimension
summary: We study how analytic functions, and more generally quasiregular mappings, distort Nagata dimension. Quasiconformal mappings of domains preserve the Nagata dimension of compact subsets, in view of a result of Lang and Schlichenmaier. We establish the same conclusion for analytic functions defined on general planar domains. On the other hand, polynomials (and more generally, rational maps) preserve the Nagata dimension of arbitrary subsets of their domain.
